svg.title: Wireframe: garage registration page (empty form, validation errors, success, registered garages list)
svg.text: Draft prepared with AI assistance (Claude Code). Owner to review: Kyash Sidhu.
Low fidelity, greyscale. Route: index.html#/admin/garages. Desktop frames (about half size). On a phone the form is one column and each list row is a stacked card.
